Articles.ContentEn:
# 1. Free API Calls

Over 60,000+ models available, with up to 2,000 free daily cumulative calls!

Supports popular models such as Qwen, DeepSeek, GLM, and MiniMax!

Covers large language models, multimodal models, text-to-image, and more.

For the complete API list, visit **ModelScope Community** → **Model Library** → **Try Now** → **Inference API**:

[**https://modelscope.cn/models?filter=inference\_type&page=2&tabKey=task**](https://modelscope.cn/models?filter=inference_type&page=2&tabKey=task)

![image](https://resouces.modelscope.cn/race/image/844c64bc-41c0-4d43-a134-a397749fcc8c.png)

# 2. Free Cloud-Based Coding (GPU/CPU Resources Provided)

Access URL: [https://modelscope.cn/my/mynotebook](https://modelscope.cn/my/mynotebook)

Detailed usage guide: [https://modelscope.cn/docs/notebook/intro](https://modelscope.cn/docs/notebook/intro)

ModelScope Notebook comes with built-in JupyterLab, WebIDE, and Terminal, offering an out-of-the-box interactive programming environment for AI developers of all skill levels—no DevOps setup required to write, debug, and run Python code.

Register on ModelScope and link your Alibaba Cloud account to receive the following free computing resources:

![image](https://resouces.modelscope.cn/race/image/49f7faa2-8b3e-4a00-86e7-8fc90cb69a4e.png)

# 3. Free Application Deployment (GPU/CPU Resources Provided)

Deploy and host applications for free on **Spaces**: [https://modelscope.cn/studios](https://modelscope.cn/studios)

Usage guide: [https://modelscope.cn/docs/studios/create](https://modelscope.cn/docs/studios/create)

CPU resources are completely free. To use GPU resources for free, you need to obtain xGPU eligibility (automatically granted upon earning the "App Buddy LV2" badge).

![image.png](https://resources.modelscope.cn/race/image/4b6fec7b-b117-4ce6-98f3-7de7400c103f.png)

![image](https://resouces.modelscope.cn/race/image/d09ce3f6-6fa4-401b-96e3-d86490fa9c7b.png)

# 4. Free Image/Video Generation and Model Training

Access URL: [https://modelscope.cn/aigc/home](https://modelscope.cn/aigc/home)

Supports multiple generation methods including text-to-image, image-to-image, text-to-video, and image-to-video. Model training features automatic cropping and labeling—simple and beginner-friendly!

![image.png](https://resources.modelscope.cn/race/image/c4b843a6-0d02-4919-847a-e6f742b60cf8.png)

**Detailed usage guide:** [https://modelscope.cn/learn/1582?pid=1577](https://modelscope.cn/learn/1582?pid=1577)

🎨 **Image/Video Generation Rules**

- **Image generation**: Consumes 1–2 MagicPoints per image, depending on the selected model.
- **Video generation**: Consumes 8–28 MagicPoints per video, varying based on complexity and duration.
- **LoRA model training**: MagicPoints consumed are dynamically calculated based on dataset size and selected model.

**Supported models**: Includes popular models such as Qwen Image 2512, Z Image, Qwen Edit 2511, and more.

**🎁 How to Earn MagicPoints**

- **Daily base allowance**: After linking your Alibaba Cloud account, log in daily to receive 150 MagicPoints.
- **Daily creation tasks**: Submit generated images to earn up to +200 MagicPoints per day.
- **Daily engagement tasks**: Complete likes and comments to earn up to +50 MagicPoints per day.
- **Model usage rewards**: Use the same model more than 3 times in a day to earn +50 MagicPoints per model, up to +200 MagicPoints daily.

**For details on MagicPoints quota:** [https://modelscope.cn/docs/aigc/aigc-quota](https://modelscope.cn/docs/aigc/aigc-quota)

# 5. More Resources

Massive collections of open-source models, datasets, MCPs, and more—freely downloadable and usable!

- **Model Library**: [https://modelscope.cn/models](https://modelscope.cn/models)
- **Datasets**: [https://modelscope.cn/datasets](https://modelscope.cn/datasets)
- **MCP**: [https://www.modelscope.cn/mcp](https://www.modelscope.cn/mcp)
- **Skills**: [https://modelscope.cn/skills](https://modelscope.cn/skills)
Articles.ContentMd:
# 1. 免费 API 调用

多达6万+模型，每日累计2000次免费调用！

支持热门模型如 Qwen、DeepSeek、GLM、MiniMax！

覆盖大语言模型，多模态模型，文生图等多个领域。

完整 API 列表可前往【魔搭社区】-【模型库】-【支持体验】-【推理API-Inference】查看：

[**https://modelscope.cn/models?filter=inference\_type&page=2&tabKey=task**](https://modelscope.cn/models?filter=inference_type&page=2&tabKey=task)

![image](https://resouces.modelscope.cn/race/image/844c64bc-41c0-4d43-a134-a397749fcc8c.png)

# 2. 免费云端写代码（提供 GPU/CPU 资源）

使用地址：[https://modelscope.cn/my/mynotebook](https://modelscope.cn/my/mynotebook)

具体使用教程可查看：[https://modelscope.cn/docs/notebook/intro](https://modelscope.cn/docs/notebook/intro)

ModelScope Notebook 内置 JupyterLab、WebIDE 以及 Terminal，为不同水平的AI开发者提供开箱即用的交互式编程环境，无需任何运维配置即可编写、调试和运行Python代码。

注册魔搭并绑定阿里云账号，即可免费获取以下算力资源：

![image](https://resouces.modelscope.cn/race/image/49f7faa2-8b3e-4a00-86e7-8fc90cb69a4e.png)

# 3. 免费部署应用（提供 GPU/CPU 资源）

创空间免费部署托管应用：[https://modelscope.cn/studios](https://modelscope.cn/studios)

使用教程：[https://modelscope.cn/docs/studios/create](https://modelscope.cn/docs/studios/create)

其中，CPU资源完全免费，如需免费使用GPU资源，则请获取xGPU资格（获得应用搭子LV2勋章自动授予）

![image.png](https://resources.modelscope.cn/race/image/4b6fec7b-b117-4ce6-98f3-7de7400c103f.png)

![image](https://resouces.modelscope.cn/race/image/d09ce3f6-6fa4-401b-96e3-d86490fa9c7b.png)

# 4. 免费的图片/视频生成与模型训练

使用地址：[https://modelscope.cn/aigc/home](https://modelscope.cn/aigc/home)

支持文生图、图生图、文生视频、图生视频等多种生成方式，模型训练支持自动裁剪、打标，简单易上手！

![image.png](https://resources.modelscope.cn/race/image/c4b843a6-0d02-4919-847a-e6f742b60cf8.png)

**具体使用教程可查看：**[https://modelscope.cn/learn/1582?pid=1577](https://modelscope.cn/learn/1582?pid=1577)

🎨 **图片/视频生成规则**

图片生成：每张图片消耗 1-2个魔粒，具体扣点与所选模型相关

视频生成：每次视频生成消耗 8-28个魔粒，根据生成复杂度与时长浮动

LoRA模型训练：训练消耗魔粒根据数据集数量和所选模型动态计算

模型支持：支持 Qwen Image 2512 、Z Image 、Qwen Edit 2511 等热门模型

**🎁 魔粒获取方式**

每日初始额度：每位用户绑定阿里云账户后，每日登录即可获得 150 魔粒

每日激励任务：完成创作返图，每日最高可获得 +200魔粒

每日任务奖励：完成点赞和评论任务，每日最高可获得 +50魔粒

模型使用奖励：同一模型单日使用超过3次，每个模型可额外获得 +50魔粒，每日最高可获得 +200魔粒

**查看魔粒额度补充说明：**[https://modelscope.cn/docs/aigc/aigc-quota](https://modelscope.cn/docs/aigc/aigc-quota)

# 5. 更多资源

海量开源模型、数据集、MCP 等免费下载和使用！

模型库：[https://modelscope.cn/models](https://modelscope.cn/models)

数据集：[https://modelscope.cn/datasets](https://modelscope.cn/datasets)

MCP：[https://www.modelscope.cn/mcp](https://www.modelscope.cn/mcp)

Skills：[https://modelscope.cn/skills](https://modelscope.cn/skills)

For the complete API list, visit **ModelScope Community** → **Model Library** → **Try Now** → **Inference API**:

[**https://modelscope.cn/models?filter=inference\_type&page=2&tabKey=task**](https://modelscope.cn/models?filter=inference_type&page=2&tabKey=task)

![image](https://resouces.modelscope.cn/race/image/844c64bc-41c0-4d43-a134-a397749fcc8c.png)

# 2. Free Cloud-Based Coding (GPU/CPU Resources Provided)

Access URL: [https://modelscope.cn/my/mynotebook](https://modelscope.cn/my/mynotebook)

Detailed usage guide: [https://modelscope.cn/docs/notebook/intro](https://modelscope.cn/docs/notebook/intro)

ModelScope Notebook comes with built-in JupyterLab, WebIDE, and Terminal, offering an out-of-the-box interactive programming environment for AI developers of all skill levels—no DevOps setup required to write, debug, and run Python code.

Register on ModelScope and link your Alibaba Cloud account to receive the following free computing resources:

![image](https://resouces.modelscope.cn/race/image/49f7faa2-8b3e-4a00-86e7-8fc90cb69a4e.png)

# 3. Free Application Deployment (GPU/CPU Resources Provided)

Deploy and host applications for free on **Spaces**: [https://modelscope.cn/studios](https://modelscope.cn/studios)

Usage guide: [https://modelscope.cn/docs/studios/create](https://modelscope.cn/docs/studios/create)

CPU resources are completely free. To use GPU resources for free, you need to obtain xGPU eligibility (automatically granted upon earning the "App Buddy LV2" badge).

# 4. Free Image/Video Generation and Model Training

Access URL: [https://modelscope.cn/aigc/home](https://modelscope.cn/aigc/home)

Supports multiple generation methods including text-to-image, image-to-image, text-to-video, and image-to-video. Model training features automatic cropping and labeling—simple and beginner-friendly!

![image.png](https://resources.modelscope.cn/race/image/c4b843a6-0d02-4919-847a-e6f742b60cf8.png)

**Detailed usage guide:** [https://modelscope.cn/learn/1582?pid=1577](https://modelscope.cn/learn/1582?pid=1577)

🎨 **Image/Video Generation Rules**

- **Image generation**: Consumes 1–2 MagicPoints per image, depending on the selected model.
- **Video generation**: Consumes 8–28 MagicPoints per video, varying based on complexity and duration.
- **LoRA model training**: MagicPoints consumed are dynamically calculated based on dataset size and selected model.

**Supported models**: Includes popular models such as Qwen Image 2512, Z Image, Qwen Edit 2511, and more.

**🎁 How to Earn MagicPoints**

- **Daily base allowance**: After linking your Alibaba Cloud account, log in daily to receive 150 MagicPoints.
- **Daily creation tasks**: Submit generated images to earn up to +200 MagicPoints per day.
- **Daily engagement tasks**: Complete likes and comments to earn up to +50 MagicPoints per day.
- **Model usage rewards**: Use the same model more than 3 times in a day to earn +50 MagicPoints per model, up to +200 MagicPoints daily.

**For details on MagicPoints quota:** [https://modelscope.cn/docs/aigc/aigc-quota](https://modelscope.cn/docs/aigc/aigc-quota)
